title: Mechanistic and kinetic insights into the radical scavenging capacity and Keap1-Nrf2 inhibition potency of A-type avenanthramides: DFT and molecular docking.
authors: Li, Jiayi; Wang, Guirong; Zhang, Zhennan; Jin, Shuang; Ai, Fengwei; An, Lin; Zhong, Haiyang; Zhang, Ling; Zheng, Youguang; Liu, Hongli; Xue, Yunsheng
one_liner_zh: 该文用DFT和分子对接研究燕麦生物碱的抗氧化及Keap1-Nrf2抑制，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Avenanthramides (AVAs), unique polyphenols in oats, have received much attention due to their biologically beneficial properties. Herein, density functional theory (DFT) calculations and molecular docking were performed to elucidate the structure-antioxidant capacity relationship and underlying mechanism of A-type AVAs under physiological conditions. Further, the interaction effects between AVAs and Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1) for activating the Nrf2-ARE (nuclear factor-E2-related factor 2-antioxidant response element) signaling pathway were explored. The results showed that the representative A-type AVA 2 c(d) displayed excellent HOO(*) scavenging capacity in water at physiological pH with an overall rate constant (k(overall) = 2.97 x 10(7) M(-1) s(-1)) higher than that of reference antioxidants Trolox and BHT, while moderate capacity in lipid-like media. Formal hydrogen atom transfer (fHAT) mechanism is more favored in lipid media, whereas in aqueous solution at physiological pH, the hydrogen transfer from dianion species plays a dominant role (99.4%) in the overall reactivity. The results also highlighted the effects of central double bond, hydroxyl, carboxyl and solvents in antiradical processes. Molecular docking and DFT calculations showed that 2c and 2 c(d) can bind strongly to Keap1 through hydrogen bonding and cysteine residues based covalent binding, which disrupts the Keap1-Nrf2 interaction. Collectively, 2c and 2 c(d) are promising candidates as multifunctional antioxidant with radical trapping and Nrf2 activation effects.
abstract_zh: 燕麦生物碱（AVAs）是燕麦中特有的多酚类化合物，因其有益的生物学特性而受到广泛关注。本研究采用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算和分子对接，阐明了生理条件下A型AVAs的结构-抗氧化能力关系及其潜在机制。进一步探讨了AVAs与Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）之间的相互作用效应，以激活Nrf2-ARE（核因子E2相关因子2-抗氧化反应元件）信号通路。结果表明，代表性A型AVA 2c(d)在生理pH值的水中表现出优异的HOO(·)清除能力，其总速率常数（k(总) = 2.97 x 10(7) M(-1) s(-1)）高于参考抗氧化剂Trolox和BHT，而在类脂介质中则表现出中等能力。形式氢原子转移（fHAT）机制在脂质介质中更为有利，而在生理pH值的水溶液中，来自二价阴离子物种的氢转移在总反应性中占主导地位（99.4%）。结果还强调了中心双键、羟基、羧基和溶剂在抗自由基过程中的作用。分子对接和DFT计算表明，2c和2c(d)可通过氢键和基于半胱氨酸残基的共价结合与Keap1强结合，从而破坏Keap1-Nrf2相互作用。总体而言，2c和2c(d)作为具有自由基捕获和Nrf2激活效应的多功能抗氧化剂，是有前景的候选化合物。
